about.bio: I'm Diego Cabrera. For 7+ years I've built procedure portals, enterprise platforms and mission-critical systems for Colombian government agencies, city governments and private-sector organizations — from insurers like Positiva to startups and freelance clients. My day splits between defining architecture, writing code and leading teams that deliver without losing technical depth.
